raw_translation: Yana amfani da wata ƙungiya na dokoki da aka bayyana a bayyane, mai dakuna biyu, mai 'yan wasa biyu Paplu-style tare da jokers biyu da aka buga, mai adawa daya na cikin gida, da kuma ZXQPH0000QXZ-card declaration check. Ba za'a iya cire katin da aka karɓa daga ƙofar karɓa da wuri ba. Babu sakamako, saka hannun jari, kudi, wasa a kan intanet ko kuma zaɓin dokar gidan. Bot ɗin na da sauki kuma ba zai iya yin wasa da hanzari ba.
source: Uses one clearly stated two-deck, two-player Paplu-style ruleset with two printed jokers, one local opponent, and a 13-card declaration check. A card taken from the discard pile cannot be discarded immediately. No scoring, stakes, cash, online play or house-rule selection. The bot is basic and may not play strategically.
translation: Yana amfani da wata ƙungiya na dokoki da aka bayyana a bayyane, mai dakuna biyu, mai 'yan wasa biyu Paplu-style tare da jokers biyu da aka buga, mai adawa daya na cikin gida, da kuma 13-card declaration check. Ba za'a iya cire katin da aka karɓa daga ƙofar karɓa da wuri ba. Babu sakamako, saka hannun jari, kudi, wasa a kan intanet ko kuma zaɓin dokar gidan. Bot ɗin na da sauki kuma ba zai iya yin wasa da hanzari ba.

raw_translation: Wannan yana bayyana bayanan da kake bayarwa; ba ya koyar da ko tabbatar da wani nau'i. AUC kadai ba ya nuna daidaitawa, adalci, amfanin likita ko aiki a kan bayanai masu sabon. Kada ka yi amfani da ma'auni guda don yin shawarwari masu tsada. Babu abin da aka tura.
source: This describes the data you provide; it does not train or validate a model. AUC alone does not show calibration, fairness, clinical usefulness or performance on new data. Do not use a single metric to make high-stakes decisions. Nothing is uploaded.
translation: Wannan yana bayyana bayanan da kake bayarwa; ba ya koyar da ko tabbatar da wani nau'i. AUC kadai ba ya nuna daidaitawa, adalci, amfanin likita ko aiki a kan bayanai masu sabon. Kada ka yi amfani da ma'auni guda don yin shawarwari masu tsada. Babu abin da aka tura.
